ok.text: The vault is running. The root key was assembled from shares and exists only in memory — a pod restart will require unsealing.

okAuto.text: The vault is running. The root key was obtained automatically and exists only in memory.

shamir.text: The server is sealed. Each holder enters their key share. Once the threshold is reached, the barrier opens automatically.
shamir.assembling: Threshold reached · assembling the root key…
shamir.toastAcceptedMsg: {{got}} of {{need}} — hand over to the next holder

auto.text: This seal type unseals automatically — no key share is needed. Tuck requests the root key from an external KMS.

toast.sealedMsg: Secret access is stopped until unsealing
toast.rotatedMsg: The active data key was replaced
toast.reconnectedMsg: The Tuck API responds, state refreshed
toast.stillDownMsg: The Tuck API is still not responding

banner.title: Tuck API unreachable
banner.text: GET /v1/sys/seal-status did not respond. Check the network, the certificate and the pods.

activity.stable: unchanged since the page was opened
activity.noSealed: no data: the vault is sealed

ha.label: HA
ha.single: Single node: the Raft cluster is not used.

rotate.title: Rotate the encryption key?
rotate.message: A new data key will be created and all entries re-encrypted with it. The root key stays the same.
rotate.warn1: ! While re-encryption runs, the barrier may be unavailable.
rotate.warn2: Secret reads and writes may return 503; clients retry on their own.

sealModal.title: Seal the server?
sealModal.message: Secret access will stop until the vault is unsealed.
sealModal.warn1: ! Applications will lose access to secrets, ServiceAccount logins will return 503.
sealModal.warn2: Unsealing will need the key share holders.
sealModal.check: I understand the consequences and agreed the outage with the security on-call
sealModal.needCheck: Confirm that you understand the consequences
